avis.titre: I usually love this product but...
avis.texte: My holy grail for a long time! I never go to bed without at least applying this one product. However, my latest purchase was super watery and seemed defective. Ulta was wonderful and took it back. Will repurchase once the defective batch clears.

I bought this to use after a dermatologist procedure. What the Dr gave was just ok but I was told by a friend to try this. It is thick and was a good final layer to the products given by the dr. Now I am continuing to use this as my final layer at night to seal in all my other products. Keep in mind, its thick but very healing!

This is a five star product. I am 56 years old and have developed very dry skin. This takes away all dryness and tightness and smooths fine lines. Do not hesitate to buy it because some people say the The ingredients separates just massage the tube first is definitely worth it!
Highly recommend- never irritating, first looks thick but it rubs in.

Okay I will say, however the formula works, it will leak everywhere when trying to get it out if the tube, but it is so worth it. My skin had been a nightmare for months, very sensitive, clogged pores and cystic acne. This has helped heal my skin so well. I have oily skin and even with how thick this is, it hasn't caused any issues.

I love this product and it's absolutely amazing! Yes sometimes separating happens when it's exposed to cold temperatures below 41ºF making it freeze and when it thaws the thermal spring water inside separates causing a watery liquid to come out. It's still safe to use and keeps its full strength, and can be fixed easily by soaking the sealed tube in a cup of warm water for a few minutes. Then take it out and massage or shake the tube to re-emulsify the thermal water and cream.

The procuts wasn't too bad, I liked it at first but eventually it started breaking me out in whiteheads and little red pimples. I still use is on certain parts of my face that aren't as acne prone, but I don't love it as much as I thought I would. I do have very acne prone, red, sensitive, combo skin with perioral dermatitis, so this might work great for someone who isn't as acne prone!

This is one of the best skin care products I have ever discovered. I put it on any area of irritated or problem skin. I have used it on areas that need healing, for example breakout areas, and on scars from derm procedures. The results are amazing and I am sure this helps with healing. I have also never had any problems with this product at all arriving in good condition, which I have seen in some of the reviews. I have bought many, many tubes of this over many years and this is one thing I will never be without in my skin care lineup.

Thia moisturizer is is my holy grail. It is calming and insanely moisturizing. I use .1 tret and this is the only moisturizer that doesn't burn if I get too dry. If you happen to get a tube that is separated, all you have to do is shake until it recombines (it takes a bit of effort but its worth it!).

avis.titre: If you get a good one, its good good
avis.texte: If you get a good tube (toothpaste texture) it's a win. Razor burn? check! Post sun sensitivity or dryness? check! Over did the actives and exfoliants? check!!
Great cream ! Helps for your skin barrier if it is messed up and helps for rosacea flare ups. But also use it on other occasion's. Would not be without it.

avis.titre: I used to love this one

It was obviously watery when I first opened it, so I shook it which helped. It's very moisturizing and did what I hoped it would. The only problem was that it caused me to break out. If you're acne-prone, I don't recommend this product, unfortunately, because it's really nice.

I love this product and this is my third time buying it! I use it at least three times a week for an even skin. I have an oily skin so I don't use it everynight but it can also be used on every part of the body. I have a very sensitive skin that even small bug stings leave black dots on my skin and I had horrible black marks from poison ivy on my legs that were there for five months!! And it took them away completely after 2 months of using this product. It also works well for old scars just need some time and constant use. Make sure to take before and after pictures and you'll notice the difference😉

i cant get over how great this makes my skin look and im very acne prone and been using it over a week not one zit! also I have seb derm i have not had one flair up since using it,ive spent 1000s of dollars on moisturizers just to be disappointed,this is hands down the best I am 40 year old female I will never buy anything else again,worth every cent!

I think I've bought this proudct about 7 times at this point. I used to use it ever once in a while and now moved to every nice since upgrading to a nightly azaleic acid/tret combo. I wake up with the most huttery soft skin. I just wish I lived closer to France to buy this in bulk for much cheaper!!

I LOVE THIS STUFF! It has so many uses. I have used it to heal skin irritation from chafing, it helped when my skin got angry after shaving, and I've used it when my skin feels really dry and needs moisure. I have super sensitive skin and eczema and my skin loves this stuff. It really does advance the healing process of everything! I used it to soothe sunburn too. I am buying the big tube now for sure!
Possibly a good product but hard to tell since the one I received was separated and all the oil pours out when you open the tube.

I've tried so many creams to repair my skin barrier, and Cicalfate is by far the best. It calmed my irritated, sensitive skin and made it look healthier within just a few days. I also had fine lines on my forehead from constantly raising my eyebrows and making expressions, and with consistent use, they have noticeably softened. My skin looks smoother, healthier, and more radiant overall. The best part is that it never caused any breakouts, unlike other repairing creams I've tried. This has become a staple in my skincare routine, and I highly recommend it to anyone with sensitive or damaged skin. I will definitely keep repurchasing it!
This is the best product to moisturize and soften the face. Use each morning and evening. Great product!!

I purchased this cream specifically to use around my eyes as I have been having some redness and flaking as of late; it absorbs well, doesn't cause me to tear up and has helped tremendously with healing the redness and flakiness. I'm honestly not sure why I am suddenly having the irritation in the first place but it has resolved nicely with this cream. I had been using CeraVe healing ointment but I can't use that and then put concealer on; this cream layers nicely with sunblock and concealer

I was a little unsure about this cream but I really needed a cream for restoring my skin barrier. After reading reviews about product separation I shook it and squeezed it around a few times before opening it. I think because the weather is warmer it didn't separate at all so if it's cold when you get it warm it a bit and shake. The cream itself is thick but surprisingly applies very smoothly despite being a zinc oxide based cream. You can feel it on your skin but hey, if it helps my skin I'll deal with it. I noticed a calming effect after using it and my skin is less angry and red. It's way too expensive for the amount you get though. Luckily I got it on sale and would probably only get it again when it's on sale. But it works well for damaged skin barriers
When your dermatologist tells you that you need this, listen. In a matter of days, my skin has improved dramatically.

avis.titre: How to reconstitute this product (watery to cream)
avis.texte: I was told to do this and it works: place tube in hot water for 10 min, shake tube a ton, place tube back in hot water 5 min, shake a ton again. Ta da! Returned to cream again. Otherwise great cream!
So rich but delicate. Super hydrating, but does not leave your skin oily. I have been using daily as my AM moisturizer. Minus a star- wish it was bigger, more product. But 100% rec!
Unfortunately bought a defective product, clumpy and watery! Ulta was amazing and refunded no problem - I did not repurchase.

Purchased this cream and it was completely broken down and separated within the tube. There was no trying to reconstitute the cream. After further reading about it, seems like manufacturer has an issue they need to correct.

After using this once, I completely understood why it's such a dermatologist‑recommended holy grail. Anytime my skin barrier needs serious support — winter dryness, post‑laser irritation, or retinol sensitivity — this cream comes to the rescue. It's deeply soothing without being harsh or irritating, and a little goes a long way. It's gentle enough that I feel comfortable using it on my kids when needed. By morning, my skin feels calm, hydrated, and looks like I just had a facial. This isn't an every‑night product for me, but it's my absolute go‑to rescue.

I absolutely love this soothing cream, I have dry and sensitive skin due to a thyroid disease and use this as a last step in my skincare routine every night. When my skin is super irritated I use it as a sort of mask, while I do agree that the formula should be more stable for separation of the cream and the blue spring water. A quick reddit search showed me a solution of putting the tube in hot water for a minute or two, then shaking it up like crazy, then the mixture combines, let it cool in the fridge, and problem fixed. I've been using this for a long while but have never written a review until now, will repurchase for as long as I can.

I bought this cream last week and I wish I looked at the rest of the reviews before I purchased. The cream and the liquid separate and it leaks out and doesn't apply well as a result. I'm super disappointed given the price - is this the standard?
Had to return this because I think the product expired. Opening the tube and oil leaked out everywhere. There was no way to mix the product after it separated.
I am very pleased with results. My skin is clearing of large pores and helps with fine lines. Perfect moisturizer.

The product that I have been eyeing for honestly a few months, I was super hesitant to purchase due to how sensitive and reactive my skin is. I finally gave it a shot as I had a coupon that saved me a few bucks. I had heard from a close friend of mine that she recently purchased and absolutely loved this for her and her baby! So far, I've been using it for probably two weeks and have not had any issues which I am pleasantly surprised, and super happy about it! I will definitely repurchase when I am done!

avis.titre: I would by over and over again forever!

I was recently diagnosed with a mild case of rosacea. This takes out all the redness and evens skin tone and moisturizes all day! It's really that good!

This is truly the best product, and nothing will compare to it for me. I have very sensitive skin to the point even laroche burns my skin. This is the only product that soothes my skin and helps with my retinol trestment. 10000/10 recommend.

I just thread my lotion and squeezed out excess water. I been using it and it is working.
Really comforts my skin barrier after using actives at night.

Very disappointed. I bought this product from one Ulta location and when I opened it water spilled everywhere nonstop. I have sworn by cicalfate for years. The last few I have ordered from ulta have all been watery. When I go to squeeze the lotion out I get a handful of water. It's annoying and messy.

I have used Avene products fior years & their barrier cream is amazing. I sensitive skin and its the perfect nighttime moisturizer. A little goes a long way, so a tube last for awhile. All the people complaining about it being watery just don't understand the product. It has thermal spring water in it, so when you first get it, just massage the tube for about a minute before opening & its fine after that.

I received a sample of this at the dermatologist and loved it so I ordered a full sized tube. The cream i just received is actually just a watery mess with gross looking solids mixed in. Do not order.

I opened the second bottle, it was unsealed and a blue liquid shot all over me. I've purchased this cream several times before with no issue, it has always been properly sealed and never liquidy. Extremely alarming. Unsure if this is an Ulta store issue or quality control issue with Avene….either way disappointing and returning immediately.

My go-to when my skin is irritated. It's thick but not greasy and helps calm redness fast. I use it at night when my barrier feels off, and I wake up with smoother, happier skin. A little goes a long way.

I bought this product after hearing all the great things about it. My bottle had completely separated and was mainly water. I will be returning this. Hopefully its a bad batch because if this is whst the product is like we have all been had.
Upon opening blue-tinted water started pouring out, like the product separated? Very bizarre.

I've bought this cream before and loved it, I thought it did a good job of soothing my sensitive skin. I guess I should have read the recent reviews first before buying a new bottle. Water started squirting out as soon as I opened it. I tried shaking it and mixing it and nothing happened, the product has completely separated. I bought it in store and it was sealed so I know it hadn't been tampered with. Either this company is sending out a bad batch of this product or they've changed their formula so much it's unusable. DO NOT BUY. I will be returning it.

Messed up my skin barrier with actives. This stuff is great at bedtime. No sting. Waking up with fresh looking skin. I like that it's healing and you can use it on broken skin which is what I'm dealing with on my face.

I damaged my skin barrier back in September after using a prescription retinoid too quickly. By November, I stopped using all actives, but I ended up developing perioral dermatitis anyway. I was officially diagnosed in December and prescribed both topical and oral medications. Unfortunately, nothing worked. The prescriptions didn't help, and when I tried other recommended actives like azelaic acid, my skin actually got worse. By December and January, my perioral dermatitis was the worst it had ever been even though I had completely stopped actives and was following my prescriptions. Out of desperation, I simplified everything and stopped using moisturizers I thought were "safe." I went down to just this product and the same gentle cleanser I had been using the entire time. This product became my holy grail. I've never written a skincare review before, but I genuinely felt like I needed to share this. I started using it in January, and my skin is now completely healed. After months of struggling, irritation, and frustration, this was the only thing that finally worked for me. If you're dealing with perioral dermatitis or a damaged skin barrier, it might be worth simplifying your routine and giving this a try.
Like other reviewers, I returned this product because it was separated.

This cream was all water. I tried to knead it as suggested without luck . After expelling all liquid I was left with half of a tube. I used it because it's all I had. The areas I used it on became angry looking, more intense itchiness. The date was a year away from being out of code. The tube was sealed tightly with the silver barrier tab securely in place. I do not recommend this product.

I have no idea why, and reading the other reviews they say the same thing but that it doesn't affect anything. Even so, I'll still use it, but I am intrigued by the fact that the texture is separate or that it contains water.

I was having major skin barrier issues and I saw such a difference after onyl a few days using this. I use every night and lather a decent amount on my face. The only thing that could knock a star is that there was water in the tube. I google it and this happens when the temperature fluctuates from cold to hot (we recently has freezing cold weather) and creates the product to separate, but said it's just as effective. I didn't return but will make sure to check moving forward and return for a replacement if needed.

avis.titre: I love this product but it is frequently faulty
avis.texte: I have been a fan of this product for several years. But twice now I have received a faulty tube. Blue liquid comes out instead of cream. I'm not sure if this is a manufacturing defect or a result of freezing during transit, but it is unacceptable for a brand of this caliber.

You are paying for water in a tube. Shaking it does nothing because you are SHAKING WATER, and kneading the tube will expel water everywhere despite the cap being on. Maybe it's not like this when you buy in store, but a waste of money.

I received some samples from my dermatologist as I was having some mystery itching on my chest and neck. It seems to work okay, but I can't understand what could possibly warrant the cost. Nothing in the ingredients is special. Mineral oil, zinc, vegetable oil? glycerin and fancy water. Just get zinc diaper cream.
My tube came with liquid completely seperated. I tried everything and could not fix it. It also smelled rancid!!! Will be returning. Dont waste your money.

The size 3.3fl oz came with the blue water separated, so almost half of the tube was this fluid. I tried to mix in tube but was unsuccessful. I did develope itchy areas on places I used the remaining lotion on. I would not recommend this size, maybe smaller size will have less problems. The separation may be due to cold weather, so results may vary.

avis.titre: Feels great on the skin, sinks in and moisturizes
avis.texte: I had a laser treatment on my face four days ago and while researching post-treatment care, I saw this Avene Cicalfate recommended on a variety of websites. I happened upon it in Ulta today and decided to give it a try. It's absolutely wonderful! My skin isn't as raw and red as it had been but still looks blotchy and it feels tight and this is the first lotion I've used that feels like it skins into the skin and really moisturizes. I understand there's a place for the ointments immediately post-procedure but I wish I'd had this on hand sooner. I've seen complaints about liquid separating from the cream but that wasn't an issue here at all. It's smooth and easy to apply and I love it!
Deep moisture with a very light feel. Helps to heal chapped or flaky skin patches when applied AM and PM.

Save yourself some coin and just get diaper rash cream instead, which has a high zinc oxide content to help with calming inflammation and glycerine for hydration. I'm almost certain this Avene cream gives me dermatitis around my nose. I thought it couldn't possibly be this cream causing the issue until I saw other reviewers with similar issues. I also think it's crazy that they charge so much for a product that uses mineral oil.

I love this product! yes it can be watery at first but I found if you Knead the product instead of shaking it, it help incorporate the water into the product.. I actually prefer a water based product because it means less harsh chemicals.

Horrible formula with major separation. When you squeeze the tube, a large amointod bluish tont water squirts out, as if it separated. When yoire lucy wnough to get actual product out, it works grest on irritated skin. I coild r get past getting sprayed with wster evedytime i try to use it so i returned it.

This was recommended to me by my doctor who is currently treating me for a severe vitamin deficiency issue that has resulted in scurvy and other issues. As a result I have extremely dry skin that does not get better and after only 2 weeks it WORKS!

This product clearly separated as a bunch of water comes out every time I try to use it. I tried shaking it together but it still happens. Not just a bit of water, a lot! That's gross and I can't imagine that's what's supposed to happen. Tried contacting guest services but as usual they were useless. Save your money!
This cream was my holy grail for a year and then they changed the formula and it started breaking my skin out.

I absolutely love this cream! I was influenced by TT to try and I have no regrets. I have very dry and sensitive skin and this cream hydrates along with calms my skin. I've been using this since November and it has not made me break out more or dried me out. Would highly recommend. My second tube did have the separation however if you squish the tube a few times before usage it does not come out as sepatated as some have said.

avis.titre: Dont keep it if you open it and it has any liquid or water!!
avis.texte: I unfortunately bought this and when I opened it, there was a bit of water/liquid that came out first then the cream. It does effect how this product works despite the manufacturer saying it doesn't. I would just avoid it all together. I am out almost $30 for this!

I have a small sample size of this that is my favorite. It makes my skin so moisturized and soft. So I splurged and bought the full size and am very disappointed. The separation is so bad! I have tried all that I can to mix it, but it will not combine, so it does not work very well. I adored this before this tube and will likely never repurchase.

Was wondering what my issue was with the product until I read some recent reviews. I guess that during shipping if the product gets cold it separates. Pretty disappointing to have a bunch of blue water shoot out of the packaging during the first use. If possible I would buy this product in store and not order it online.

This has been a lifesaver for my rosacea over the last year. Sadly, it has been reformulated and it's garbage. They have also increased the price! I used to be able to get 3.3 oz for $26 and now it's over $40.

I have loved using the Revitalizing Nourshing Cream, so when Ulta had a sale before Christmas I bought that and Cicalfate for my dry skin and ezcema. This is a throwaway product at this point unless Ulta will refund. The separation is real and a total mess. I have shaken the tube, smooshed the tube and other things in hopes of getting the water to combine with the solid in the tube. Nothing works. Please don't buy this. Stick to the Revitalizing Nourishing Cream. That product is legit!

avis.titre: Seperates if shipped during freezing temps.
avis.texte: I ordered this and it came in completely separated. After massaging the tube to try to get it to blend back together, it only formed curds inside blue water. Ended up going to the store to return it and got one in person that is not damaged by cold shipping.

I ordered this as a reccomendation for perioral dermatitis that i got while pregnant. I have been using it for a few weeks and it doesnt help my dryness go away very much. My skin is still flakey after applying this liberally.
Got rid of my unexplained rash of a year in one application!!!!

I bought a tube of this after reading rave reviews about restoring your skin barrier. I opened the tube and had a bunch of blue water squirt out. This solution is impossible to emulsify with the cream and it's messy and you feel like your money is literally going down the drain. I would not repurchase. Quality and price do not align. I understand that there can be issues if a product freezes, but that should be on Ulta and the brand to manage, it is not okay to knowingly give your customers a faulty and inconsistent product.

This was purchased with the intention to add to my tret nights. It has been helpful to buffer the intensity of my tret and lightens the irritation by a lot. My preferred method is slathering this on my face, almost like a face mask, and sleep with it on. When I wake up, my skin is soft, supple and zero irritation.

avis.titre: Not good for my truly acne prone skin
avis.texte: I started having breakouts as soon as I used it. I waited for over 30 days to make sure it wasn't just purging. My skin reverted back to high school. It was not moisturizing enough for my skin at all. Felt dry and tight within a couple of hours. Could be great for someone but not me.

avis.titre: I want this product so badly! In the large size!

When i returend the 3.3oz i looked for another, the others at the store had the same consistency issue, i shook all of the boxes in stock. So BE WARNED; the 3.3oz has a consistency issue but for whatever reason the smaller ones don't? Atleast the one i got. Problem is i want the LARGE bottle because i love this product and i would rather get the value size. (BTW shaking the product does nothing benefical, the product is clearly broken) What the heck Aveene!! Lets figure it out.
Tqhis has been a godsend product for my skin and the repairing of my barrier. I also use it on my hands as i live in a very dry state.

In the past year i buy in store and it came really good and works but unfortunately this time i purchase online in ulta beauty app and half of it came with a blue water instead …waste my money , it should be cream and not the blue water i received ☹️

The product completely separated to the point of unsuability. If i shake it, it sounds like a water bottle in there. You can pour out the liquid to keep the "cream" but then you lose so many ingredients that make this cream! Absolute waste

When I tell you it was GONE in two days of me applying this after washing my face. My skin was glowing and the small breakouts I had CEASED to exist. I recieved many compliments on my skin (that never happens). If youre suffering, get it! Just GET IT!!

First off, I typically LOVE this product. However, I can only buy it in Europe as every time I have purchased it in the US it comes separated and a blue liquid pours out if the tube when you open it. I have very sensitive dry skin. My skin easily turns red and gets oily. This product moisturizes and does not make me oily , break out or turn red. Healthy glow. It takes a little effort in rubbing in but that's because it's a cream. 10/10

When I open the sealed package, there's pouring of liquid coming out from the tube. It was supposed to be cream texture, but it has melted and can no longer be used. The expiration date is May 2028 so no sure what happened l
I have combo skin (acne prone) and this has helped heal my barrier and texture. Doesnt break me out and gives me a nice moisture without feeling greasy. It is thick and a little goes a long way.

I have very dry, irritated, sensitive skin around my mouth and nose… tried so many products but nothing worked until I started using this product withing a few days my skin got so much better and now I only use it once a week… for everyday use I am using their Cicalfate+ serum and their Tolerance control balm…

I have a beeswax skin sensitivity, so I thought this would help my hand eczema and I ordered it for delivery. There was liquid that got everywhere when i first opened it, tried massaging the tube for several minutes but would not mix

I have oily, acne prone skin with dry patches. A very high maintenance, difficult skin type that you tend to need multiple products for. I have only used this for less than a week, but it hasnt broken me out. It has actually healed blemishes FAST and calmed dry patches. Its a great all-in-one for me. It leaves the skin glossy (which i like). Before last night I would have given this product 5 stars. I have been using a free sample size container of this for my sensitive face eczema for over a year. I loved it and bought a full size end of last year, but did not open it until last night. I was shocked when a lot of blue water came out when squeezing product out. I tried shaking and squeezing the container to remix, as that usually works. Yet nope it's still very separated. This is very disappointing because I loved the product. I would caution to only buy in person so you can shake it to listen for the separation. Or make sure you at least open it right after buying. Even though the product is faulty, I am past the return window so I'm losing money by throwing it out. I doubt I would buy this again because I would rather support a new product than one with known issues. Not sure if its a batch or formulation issue, or extreme temperatures during transportation that causes the separation sometimes, but Avène or Ulta need to figure it out. Very disappointing!!

I have rosacea and eczema so it is extremely hard to find products that work for my face. I bought this as a moisturizer and it did okay, I just don't like how hard it is to spread and it makes my face super itchy. I used it for probably a month or two before I couldn't handle the itching then threw it at the back of the drawer. I like that it never burned the area below my eyebrows and didn't cause more breakouts than my normal. I knocked off a star for the itching but gave it 4 stars because it saved my face: I used a new face moisturizer (Bioderma Atoderm Intensive Balm) and had the most outrageous reaction on my face, neck, and upper chest, everywhere I applied it. My mom said my face looked like it had been chemically peeled it was so red and shiny looking. My skin felt tight, it burned, and I wanted to scratch my skin off it itched so badly. I remembered this cream and decided to try it (cleansed with Cetaphil cream cleanser and applied just this) and it took a few hours but the redness went down and the tightness lessened. I just had intensive itching (this probably magnified because it made me itch in general) which required me to then apply aveeno baby eczema balm on top to fix it. Because I have rosacea, I can't use steroids on my face so had to use the aveeno. This stuff is a life savor for most of the side affects of a skin reaction, so I am glad to have it on hand!
